### One prestige variant of the shared currency good.
###
### THIS USED TO BE 95, ONE PER CURRENCY, AND THAT IS WHY IT IS NOW ONE.
### Every central bank on earth minted the Iraqi dinar -- through all 95 being
### offered to every company, through one currency per company with the law gate
### still on the good, and through one currency per company with no gate at all.
### After the last of those NO company anywhere listed dinar_iraqi_dinar_c, and
### the game still showed it. So the identity is resolved per BASE GOOD, not per
### producer: 95 variants of spe_uni_c collapse onto one, and it was the third
### one defined in the file.
###
### Vanilla never puts more than three variants on one base good -- 40 base goods
### carry prestige variants, 17 with one, 14 with two, 9 with three. E&F is the
### only thing here that goes to four.
###
### What is kept: the prestige bonus, the +20% throughput for buildings that
### consume it, and the fact that only a company-owned central bank produces it.
### What is lost: the per-country name and icon on the belt. The currency itself
### is untouched -- every country still has its own monetary system law, its own
### production method in the bank, and its own name in E&F's currency interface.
